claim.claim-text: 1. A method, comprising:

2. The method according to claim 1, where determining the offset comprises calculating the offset using one of the following equations: Offset = α × distance between the dots of the mark / distance to the mark
Offset = β × distance between the dots of the mark 14 × γ + motor position ;
and Offset = η × measured distance between the dots of the mark
where the values of a, β and γ, and η are empirical constants that depend on the autofocus mechanism and the lens (24, 124).

3. The method according to claim 1 or 2, further comprising repeating the applying, setting, acquiring, and providing, with a gradually increasing offset, until the decoder successfully decodes the image of the mark (14).

4. The method according to any of claims 1 to 3, further comprising determining the offset by adding offset values incrementally to the calculated focus position until space between dots in the image of the mark (14) are merged in the acquired image.
5. The method according to any of claims 1 to 4, where the offset causes adjacent dots in the mark (14) to appear merged in the acquired image.
6. The method according to any of claims 1 to 5, further comprising determining the offset prior to applying the offset.
7. The method according to any of claims 1 to 6, further comprising determining whether or not the image to be acquired is that of a dot peened mark (14) and if not, setting the offset to zero.
8. The method according to any of claims 1 to 7, further comprising decoding the mark (14) by using the acquired image of the mark (14).
9. A mark reader apparatus, comprising:

10. The apparatus according to claim 9, where a value of the offset is determined by calculating the offset using one of the following equations: Offset = α × distance between the dots of the mark / distance to the mark 14 ;
Offset = β × distance between the dots of the mark 14 × γ + motor position ;
and Offset = η × measured distance between the dots of the mark 14 ;
where the values of a, β and γ, and η are constants that depend on the autofocus mechanism and the lens (24, 124).

11. The apparatus according to claim 10, further comprising determining the offset by adding, by the processor, offset values incrementally to the calculated focus position until space between dots in the image of the mark (14) are merged in the acquired image.
12. The apparatus according to any of claims 9 to 11, where the offset causes adjacent dots in the mark (14) to appear merged in the acquired image.

13. The apparatus according to any of claims 9 to 12, where the processor (100) is further programmed to determine whether or not the image to be acquired is that of a dot peened mark (14) and if not, set the offset to zero.
14. The apparatus according to any of claims 9 to 13, where the decoder decodes the mark (14) by using the acquired image of the mark (14).
15. The apparatus according to any of claims 9 to 14, where the autofocus system (132) comprises a motor, and where the offset comprises an offset to a motor position.
